waveVerdicts.item: Secret-free child environments across every child execution path.
waveVerdicts.qualification: MCP stdio builds a bounded child env, while shell/browser/computer/desktop retain ambient process access.

authorityChecks.needle: ambient process.env is not inherited wholesale

waveVerdicts.item: Shared DNS-aware and rebinding-safe web/browser navigation.
waveVerdicts.qualification: web_fetch resolves DNS; browser.navigate checks URL syntax/host classes without DNS resolution.

waveVerdicts.item: Recursive filesystem link/junction containment without check/use escape.
waveVerdicts.qualification: The path guard checks the deepest existing realpath, but no handle-relative/no-follow boundary closes TOCTOU.

waveVerdicts.item: Explicit channel pairing rather than trust-on-first-message ownership.
waveVerdicts.qualification: The shared adapter still uses trust-on-first-use owner claiming.

waveVerdicts.item: Short-lived scoped Workshop/file/SSE URL capabilities with no reusable global query token.
waveVerdicts.qualification: SSE and file loads accept the global launch token in the query string.

waveVerdicts.item: Every custom MCP call requires an exact live per-call confirmation; local stdio additionally requires an isolated process broker.
waveVerdicts.qualification: MCP annotations and transport are not trusted as proof of harmlessness: all connector tools are external-unknown, autonomous calls are absent, watched calls receive non-cacheable exact confirmation, and stdio defaults off without broker-proven isolation.

authorityChecks.needle: unknown external effects require a watched, exact per-call confirmation

waveVerdicts.item: Boot performs zero outbound egress before user consent/configured need.
